lines: CASTLE SCHOOL: TIMETABLE. Woodwork, Chemistry and Botany are taught in lesson time. Physics, Domestic Science and the sixth period at break.
The sixth period has no subject against it. Someone has drawn a snowflake there, in the same hand, in ink.
Periods are rung from the hall. The rope is by the stair and it is kept up to date.
BOILER ROOM. Caretaker only. The boiler is checked at six and again at six.
The stair behind it is marked on the plan as going down. It is warm, and there is grit on the steps that is not from this floor.
Sixty pegs, numbered to sixty. Forty-one coats on them, and the floor underneath is dry.
Every one of them is buttoned to the collar.
A school clock in a wooden case. The card inside says it has run a minute fast since 1954 and is not to be adjusted.
It is still a minute fast. The case is already open.
SICK BAY. The near bed is turned down and the card at the head of it says six o'clock, as it does for everybody.
There is a glass of water on the locker. It is full.
A card is pinned over this one: YOU WILL BE WOKEN AT THE BELL. The bell is at nine in the evening.
Underneath, in pencil and a different hand: the night does not pass unless everybody is lying down.
THE REGISTER. Every name in the county is in it, in one hand, going back further than the school does.
It is marked up to this morning. Nobody is absent.
The last line is {name}, and the ink is not dry.
